nodes.Name: matcher
nodes.DocComment: matcher sanitizes, uniques, and filters names of subtests and subbenchmarks.

nodes.Name: simpleMatch
nodes.DocComment:
simpleMatch matches a test name if all of the pattern strings match in
sequence.

nodes.Name: alternationMatch
nodes.DocComment: alternationMatch matches a test name if one of the alternations match.

nodes.Name: matchMutex
nodes.DocComment:
TODO: fix test_main to avoid race and improve caching, also allowing to
eliminate this Mutex.

nodes.Name: clearSubNames
nodes.DocComment:
clearSubNames clears the matcher's internal state, potentially freeing
memory. After this is called, T.Name may return the same strings as it did
for earlier subtests.

nodes.Name: unique
nodes.DocComment:
unique creates a unique name for the given parent and subname by affixing it
with one or more counts, if necessary.

nodes.Name: parseSubtestNumber
nodes.DocComment:
parseSubtestNumber splits a subtest name into a "#%02d"-formatted int32
suffix (if present), and a prefix preceding that suffix (always).

nodes.Name: rewrite
nodes.DocComment:
rewrite rewrites a subname to having only printable characters and no white
space.
